back: Dr Income statement (depreciation); Cr Provision for depreciation.

front: Why keep the asset account at cost?
back: So the statement of financial position shows both the cost and the depreciation to date.
A credit-balance (contra-asset) account holding total depreciation charged so far.

front: Income statement vs statement of financial position
back: Income statement: this year's charge. SOFP: cost − accumulated depreciation = net book value.
Usually the opening balance: add this year's charge before using it in the SOFP.

front: Reducing balance from a trial balance

back: Cost | Accumulated depreciation | Net book value, one line per class, then totals.

front: Is the provision for depreciation a liability?
back: No. It is deducted from the asset's cost; nothing is owed.
